variants.text: Eight columns, evenly set, holding a roof. And a ninth, off the pattern, holding nothing, weeping warm salt water in a place four hundred miles from any sea. The guild's own section of this hall is on a brass plate and it has eight.
It is warm. Everything else down here takes the warmth out of you and this gives it back, which is worse.
The shaft above goes up further than there is rock to go up through. Somebody worked that out once and scratched out the number.
